title: Night Shift
text: Packs come at night. {who} wants armed colonists on the walls after dark, not just turrets. Others say that's what the AI is for.

choices.label: Arm a night watch
choices.reply: A rota of volunteers on the walls with flares and rifles. {who} takes the first night.

choices.label: The turrets are enough
choices.reply: The turrets keep the watch. {who} says they'll sleep when the packs do.
